title: 【上马头条】申城初冬最美的42.195公里，上马准备好了！
publisher: 上海马拉松赛前攻略（腾讯新闻转载）
claims: The 2025 Shanghai Marathon course is 42.195 km.
The guide cites the meteorological department's race-day forecast for 30 November: sunny, 10-22°C, with a marked temperature range.

Runners in corrals A, B, C and D are advised to take Metro Line 2 or 10 to Nanjing East Road and walk about 15 minutes; corral E runners are advised to take Line 10 or 12 to Tiantong Road and walk about 25 minutes.
The start uses three waves: 07:00 for invited athletes and corrals A and B, 07:10 for corral C, and 07:20 for corrals D and E.
Runners should bring the bib with timing chip, bag, pins and original identity document.
